body.objective: Turn the certified distributional charged-time event map into an exact finite-resolution sampling theorem suitable for a physical emitter/receiver once a nonradical counterflow carrier lands.
body.stop_condition: Import CHARGED_PHYSICAL_TIME_RELATIONAL_EVENT_MAP_THEOREM_V1 by exact hash. For a normalized compactly supported sampling profile kappa_epsilon, define the smeared relational map O_A^{epsilon}(tau) and prove its local BV closure, representative independence, primitive clock-orientation covariance, Q/H/K charge brackets, support inheritance and distributional epsilon-to-zero limit on a precisely declared test-function class. Derive exact finite-resolution error and composition bounds for smooth receiver periods and two transported signal phases, and state the hypotheses under which frequency ratios are phase-origin independent. Separate lifted-line monotonicity from compact-phase sampling and fixed-charge clock removal. Supply a method-distinct distributional or de Rham-current verifier, normalization/orientation/support/exact-receiver mutations, strict schema, receipt, report and atlas fragment.
body.current_gate: finite-resolution operational meaning of the charged-time chain map
body.forbid: no conditional receiver called nonzero; no coordinate-frequency ratio called redshift; no fixed-Q_rel clock resurrection; no compact phase called a globally monotone real clock; no smoothing allowed to enlarge causal support; no detector, phenomenology, nonlinear or quantum promotion
body.resource_hint: PROOF-FIRST OBSERVER THEOREM. This task is deliberately carrier-independent and may certify only a conditional map. It prepares, but cannot replace, the all-Hodge physical receiver gate.
